Package neqsim.process.equipment.absorber

Class StrippingColumn

java.lang.Object
neqsim.util.NamedBaseClass
neqsim.process.SimulationBaseClass
neqsim.process.equipment.ProcessEquipmentBaseClass
neqsim.process.equipment.distillation.DistillationColumn
neqsim.process.equipment.absorber.AbsorptionColumn
neqsim.process.equipment.absorber.StrippingColumn
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Runnable, DistillationInterface, ProcessEquipmentInterface, ProcessElementInterface, SimulationInterface, NamedInterface
public class StrippingColumn extends AbsorptionColumn
Rigorous counter-current equilibrium-tray stripper based on the distillation MESH solver.

The stripping gas enters tray zero and the rich liquid enters the highest numbered tray. Tray numbers are zero based from bottom to top. The class reuses AbsorptionColumn because absorption and stripping use the same counter-current equilibrium-stage equations; the thermodynamic driving force determines the direction of component transfer.

Overall, per-tray, per-component, and per-tray/per-component Murphree vapor efficiencies are inherited. The gas and liquid outlet streams remain ordinary NeqSim streams, and all inherited convergence, MESH residual, material-balance, energy-diagnostic, warm-start, and solver-selection APIs remain available.
